title: Rio Tinto’s Results Make the Case for Looking Beyond Tech in the AI Trade
excerpt: Rio Tinto's first-half results showed EBITDA up 28%, free cash flow up 75%, and copper EBITDA nearly doubling, as diversified metals exposure and productivit...
content_html:
Key Points

  • Interested in Rio Tinto PLC? Here are five stocks we like better.

  • Rio Tinto's first-half results showed strong cash flow, higher earnings and a larger interim dividend.

  • Copper, aluminum and lithium are becoming more important to the company as AI infrastructure, electrification and grid demand grow.

  • Iron ore remains a major cash generator, but investors still need to watch commodity prices, currency pressure and geopolitical risks.

Rio Tinto (NYSE: RIO) just delivered a first-half report with numbers that back up a broader thesis rooted in a major shift. Physical assets are entering a multi-year period of outperformance. Higher bond yields, oil supply anxieties, and an artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure buildout are converging. Rio Tinto sits at the intersection of all three trends.

Rio Tinto posted EBITDA of $14.8 billion, up 28% year-over-year. Free cash flow nearly doubled, jumping 75% to $3.8 billion. Underlying earnings rose 43% to $6.9 billion. The board responded with a $3.4 billion interim dividend, up 43% from a year ago.

→ Popular's Earnings Beat Shows Why This Bank Stock Keeps Climbing

However, the bigger story is the why. That goes back to the broader thesis that hard assets are at the beginning of a multi-year bull cycle. Copper, aluminum, and lithium now generate more than half of Rio Tinto's EBITDA. That mix gives investors direct exposure to electrification, grid buildout, and AI-driven power demand. Meanwhile, iron ore keeps the balance sheet steady through this transition.

Copper and Iron Ore Drive Rio Tinto's Diversified Growth

Copper EBITDA surged 84% to $5.7 billion, driven by the ramp-up at the company's Oyu Tolgoi project and a 39% jump in average realized copper prices. Aluminum and lithium combined rose 38% to $3.3 billion. Iron ore stayed roughly flat at $6.8 billion, still the largest single contributor.

→ SpaceX's First Earnings Report Could Decide Whether Shorts or Bulls Have Control

Here's why that balance matters. Copper is needed in the AI and electrification trade. Iron ore is a steady cash generator. Together, they reduce Rio Tinto's dependence on any single commodity cycle. That level of diversification is rare among pure-play miners.

Management also flagged accelerating productivity gains. The company banked $870 million in savings during H1, targeting a $1.8 billion annualized run-rate by year-end. Lower unit costs mean margins can hold even if commodity prices soften later in the cycle.

content_html_zh:
要点

  • 对力拓集团感兴趣？ 这是我们更喜欢的五只股票。
  • 力拓上半年业绩显示强劲的现金流、较高的盈利和较大的中期股息。
  • 随着人工智能基础设施、电气化和电网需求的增长，铜、铝和锂对公司变得越来越重要。
  • 铁矿石仍然是主要的现金来源，但投资者仍需关注大宗商品价格、货币压力和地缘政治风险。

力拓（纽约证券交易所股票代码：RIO）刚刚发布了上半年报告，其中的数据支持了植根于重大转变的更广泛的论点。 实物资产正在进入多年表现优异的时期。 债券收益率上升、石油供应焦虑和人工智能（AI）基础设施建设正在汇聚在一起。 力拓位于这三种趋势的交汇点。

力拓公布的 EBITDA 为 148 亿美元，同比增长 28%。 自由现金流几乎翻倍，跃升 75% 至 38 亿美元。 基本盈利增长 43% 至 69 亿美元。 作为回应，董事会派发了 34 亿美元的中期股息，较去年同期增长 43%。

→ 大众公司的盈利表现说明了该银行股票为何持续上涨

然而，更大的故事是原因。 这可以追溯到更广泛的论点，即硬资产正处于多年牛市周期的开始。 铜、铝和锂目前占力拓 EBITDA 的一半以上。 这种组合使投资者能够直接接触电气化、电网建设和人工智能驱动的电力需求。 与此同时，铁矿石在这一转变过程中保持了资产负债表的稳定。

铜和铁矿石推动力拓多元化增长

受该公司 Oyu Tolgoi 项目产量增加以及平均实现铜价上涨 39% 的推动，铜 EBITDA 飙升 84% 至 57 亿美元。 铝和锂合计上涨 38%，达到 33 亿美元。 铁矿石大致持平，为 68 亿美元，仍然是最大的单一贡献者。

→ SpaceX 的第一份收益报告可能决定空头还是多头拥有控制权

这就是为什么这种平衡很重要。 人工智能和电气化行业需要铜。 铁矿石是稳定的现金来源。 它们共同减少了力拓对任何单一商品周期的依赖。 这种程度的多元化在纯粹的矿工中是罕见的。

管理层还表示生产率正在加速提高。 该公司上半年节省了 8.7 亿美元，目标是到年底年化运行率为 18 亿美元。 较低的单位成本意味着即使大宗商品价格在周期后期走软，利润率也能保持不变。

→ 随着人工智能贸易的解体，金融股创下历史新高——它们能否继续领先？
